references.text: Elisur, son of Shedeur, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Reuben.
Elisur, son of Shedeur, brought his offering as the prince of the children of Reuben.
The camp of Reuben broke camp under its banner, with Elisur as its leader.
Reuben was Jacob's firstborn son and the ancestor of the tribe of Reuben.
Reuben's sons are mentioned among those who went down to Egypt.
Summary of the number in the camp of Reuben, which camped toward the south.
